answer: Layered bond: each identity holds 3 layers. The nadir layer locks 200 for 20 epochs; the pearl layer registers a pearl bed, 100 plus 40 fee; the zephyr layer locks 50, answering a fresh zephyr signal per epoch. Auditors replay logs: a missed signal, a reused pearl bed, or an early nadir withdrawal burns all layers. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 390 = 390,000 credits vs a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 40 once, recover 350. Failure: rented-layer ring.
